name: Complete the real Government Plaza prerequisite civic in the captured game

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); assert(p.stage=='NEEDS_DOMAIN_LAW' and p.occupied==1 and p.capacity==1,'normal Government Plaza Civic prerequisite changed'); b.Queue('PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC'); return 'official Civic research queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC' or a=='UNKNOWN_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC' or a=='REJECTED_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC'

steps.code: local p=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_CIVIC')); assert(p.districtCivicOwned and p.occupied==1 and p.capacity==1 and r.owner==0 and r.index==GameInfo.Civics['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_DOMAIN_LAW'].Index and r.afterSpent==r.beforeSpent,'native Civic or official title accounting differs'); return p.stage
